WITH session_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        s.seshkey,
        u.typelabel,
        u.seglabel,
        s.bncrate,

        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.ctrval DESC) AS ctr_percentile
    FROM sessions s
    JOIN users u ON s.userel = u.userkey
),
session_categories AS (
    SELECT *,
        CASE 
            WHEN bounce_percentile < 0.25 AND ctr_percentile < 0.25 THEN 'High Bounce, Low CTR'

            ELSE 'Average Performance'

    FROM session_metrics
),

    SELECT seglabel
    FROM session_categories
    GROUP BY seglabel
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
)

    sc.typelabel AS user_type,
